title: gocell-pr-meta v1
description: Machine-readable provenance + dispatch protocol carried in a hidden HTML comment after the human-readable footer of every pm:ship / pm:fix / pm:pr-review / pm:ci / pm:oos PR comment. Wire form: a single-line `<!-- gocell-pr-meta:v1 <standard-base64(JSON)> -->`. Standard base64 (alphabet A-Za-z0-9+/=, never `-`) is used instead of base64url because CommonMark forbids `--` inside an HTML comment body; base64url's `-` could emit `--` and demote the whole block to visible text. Consumed by the #935 / #1657 local executors (Codex review daemon, Claude fix monitor) to dispatch the next review<->fix step and enforce the 3-round circuit breaker. Produced solely by hack/automation/pr-meta.sh emit, which derives `schema`, `cycle.exhausted`, `next`, and `idempotencyKey` from the producer-supplied facts. pm:ci records CI check outcomes; pm:oos records out-of-scope findings for future gh issue filing.

schema.description: Schema version discriminator. The marker token `gocell-pr-meta:v1` mirrors this.

kind.description: Comment marker family (pm:ship / pm:fix / pm:pr-review / pm:ci / pm:oos).

phase.description: Pipeline stage. pr-review uses phase to distinguish a normal review (review) from a --check verification (check). ci uses check; oos uses review.

headSha.description: Full head commit SHA. Freshness anchor: a consumer compares this against the live headRefOid and discards a stale block.

session.description: Producer session id, or null if unavailable.

worktree.description: Producer worktree path, or null when working on develop directly.

verdict.description: Workflow conclusion, bound to the real label state machine (pr-status/* and pr-review/* — see .github/project-template/PROJECT.md §2.5/§5).

findings.description: Machine summary of this round's findings.

cycle.description: Circuit breaker for the automated review<->fix loop. round = number of completed fix rounds for this PR; exhausted = round >= maxRounds. When exhausted and verdict is changes-requested, emit forces next.agent=human so daemons stop dispatching and escalate.

next.description: Dispatch directive, derived by emit from (verdict, cycle). Never hand-written by producers.

agent.description: Executor that handles the next step, or null for a terminal verdict (approved/ready/ci-green).

command.description: Advisory command the next agent runs, or null.

sandbox.description: Whether the next step should run sandboxed.

triggerLabel.description: The pr-status/* label whose presence triggers the next executor, or null.

requiresSameHeadSha.description: Whether the next executor must verify headSha is unchanged before acting.

idempotencyKey.description: Derived {repo}#{pr}@{headSha}:{kind}/{phase}#{round}. Lets an executor dedup repeated dispatch on the same comment.

ci.description: CI check outcome data, present only for pm:ci comments, null otherwise.

failedChecks.description: List of failed CI check names and URLs.

oos.description: Out-of-scope findings data, present only for pm:oos comments, null otherwise. Each item is a lossless per-finding record staged for future `gh issue create`.

items.description: Per-finding OOS records. Each item carries the full finding detail needed for gh issue creation.
